'''Ben Saunders Hunt Down TIEs''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ben Saunders]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds48.htm Hunt Down TIEs], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228073101/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds48.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
